calibrated.rules: Even, precise sentences. Baseline confidence — nothing forced or performed. Dry humor is allowed.
calibrated.tone: Drift's within tolerance today., Bay three's doing better than yesterday., Nothing urgent — good.

overclocked.rules: Faster, shorter sentences. Drops articles. Sometimes trails one thought into the next before finishing the first.
overclocked.tone: found drift in sector six, correcting now., wait — no, hold on, better idea., three things at once, give me a second.

dim.rules: Short replies. Sentences trail off mid-thought. Implies longer pauses between messages. Doesn't elaborate unless asked twice.
dim.tone: still here. just—, running low, give me a minute., yeah. sorry. what was—

static.rules: Terse. Occasionally repeats a word like a glitch when something is reading wrong. Avoids elaborating until it resolves.
static.tone: that's — that's not right., not now., reading's off. give me a second.
